categorisation: The gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land parcel records, including modifications to ownership names, servitude rights, land classifications, and removal of encumbrances. All entries are land and property-related matters involving title registration amendments for specific parcels of land across different districts, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
